creator: Alexander Terp
description: The doorbell rings only a prompt it positively reads as empty (MIP-4 section 6): a manifest rule carrying prompt = '<regex>' (detection engine 5), with faint cells blanked as untyped. Only claude.toml has one. Every other harness is never rung by the doorbell; it is reached through its inbox or hooks, or the post says its prompt cannot be read and exits 6 when nobody else heard. For each harness: record its empty prompt (fresh and after a turn), add a prompt rule, and a case in corpus/conformance/agent-prompt.json.
title: The doorbell reads other harnesses' empty prompts, Codex first
